independent_move_geometry.proof: Moves use distinct initially-empty new cells and separate vehicles. Every subset is legal, all cube edges are physically replayed. Any pair needs at least one slide per changed vehicle; cube paths attain that Hamming count, hence these distances are exact in the FULL physical graph. Each different antipodal pair requires a separate active absolute-difference coordinate: two length-k pairs on one coordinate imply cross-distance sum>=2k, but their true cross sum<=2k-2. Thus exact Linf embedding of all2^k cube vertices needs at least2^(k-1) coordinates. A shared coordinate forces worst absolute distance error>=0.5. Normalized L1 represents this independent subgraph additively.
independent_move_geometry.limitations: Only sampled actual training states, not an exhaustive maximum. The lower bound concerns ALL cube state pairs, not the smaller declared training-target subset. It neither proves the current finite target bank is128D-infeasible nor bounds completion rate. This is a teacher/physics-only geometry diagnosis, never an input feature or learned result.

interpretation: The matched finite-transition-difference arm improves held-layout random-query completion466 to507/1024 and original-root10 to16/1024, but long-root execution remains far below threshold; no adoption. Original historical better model is retained. A verified9-dimensional independent-car cube in a real training scene needs256 Linf coordinates to reproduce ALL cube-pair distances exactly, versus current128; this is not an infeasibility result for the finite32-goal training pool or a bound on greedy completion. It motivates a matched from-scratch L1/Linf baseline with identical raw CNN, dimension, losses, source/target boundaries and update budget. No symbolic coordinates enter training.

training_supervision_connectivity.scope: Exact reachability inside complete TRAINING-ALLOWED decision graph, including terminal goal as sink. All physical actions remain; protected candidate closures reject a whole decision. This diagnoses supervision connectivity, not inference search or learned execution.

local_path_comparison.scope: Same init and full candidate bank, matched update budget and context multiset; joint versus shuffled within batches. Validation checkpoint selection; no adoption.
